title: Fourier Restriction Conjecture in Higher Dimensions
exact_target: For a smooth compact hypersurface with nonzero curvature in $\mathbb R^d$, prove the conjectured sharp $L^p$--$L^q$ Fourier restriction bounds in every dimension $d\geq3$. The restriction operator sends a Schwartz function to the restriction of its Fourier transform to the hypersurface; the requested range is the one dictated by the standard scaling and concentration obstructions.
